why_hard_from_docx: No public state/county balance-sheet series; Fed Flow of Funds is national only
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Use the Version A benchmark: published ACS B25082 aggregate owner values less the matched-universe, California-calibrated first-mortgage debt benchmark; add published mortgage-free owner value in full for all-owner equity.
limitation: The methodology-authorized raw PMMS 20/25/30-year debt sensitivities produce matching mortgaged-owner and all-owner equity scenarios for all 58 California counties. They are explicit uncalibrated scenarios. The official 2025 SIPP state wealth table now also produces one separately labeled 2024 California positive-home-equity sensitivity of $4,913,341,020,000 from rounded published inputs. It is conditional on positive equity, truncates the conditional mean to net worth below the 99th percentile, and has no valid covariance-based aggregate standard error. It is not the preferred matched-universe county equity target. The calibrated nominal and real equity targets remain null until an exact-date, owner-occupied first-lien California UPB control is available. The older B25106 midpoint proxy remains only as a separately labeled legacy modeled scenario.

why_hard_from_docx: ACS reports payments, not balances; no public CA/LA balance series
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Use the Version A benchmark: direct ACS B25089/B25081 levels, weighted ACS PUMS first-mortgage P&I parameters, an exact-date joint NMDB rate-term distribution, and a compatible California UPB control. Retain PMMS only as a labeled sensitivity fallback.
observed_constructed_proxy_or_scenario: scenario sensitivity|published-table sensitivity|reported-case public proxy|schema only
limitation: Version A publishes explicit raw PMMS 20/25/30-year debt sensitivities for all 58 California counties while retaining the composite raw envelope. The official 2025 SIPP state debt table adds a broader 2024 California Home Debt sensitivity of $1,627,458,504,000. The official 2023 California AHS Table 14A adds a reported-case primary-mortgage proxy of $1,413,679,720,000 from 3,381,200 reported-bin households times the $418,100 conditional mean. AHS excludes 1,203,800 regular-mortgage households with no reported balance (26.2540 percent), does not make a missing-at-random extrapolation, may not match legal first-lien status, and has no covariance-based aggregate uncertainty measure. Neither public sensitivity matches the current Version A target universe and 2022-07-01 reference date exactly. Calibrated debt and normalized ratios remain null; the older B25106 proxy remains a separate legacy construction.

variable_name: Rental price increase in non-rent-controlled locations
sheet_variable_name: Rental price increase in non–rent-controlled locations
why_hard_from_docx: Public rent indices do not flag rent-control status
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Use Zillow ZORI with the methodology-listed ACS B25032/B25127 renter structure and year-built inputs. Preserve lower/upper structural exposure bounds because published ACS bins cannot recover an exact rolling 15-year cutoff; construct an exact point exposure only after a complete dated property-level policy and exemption crosswalk is available.
observed_constructed_proxy_or_scenario: observed rent index|constructed structural proxy bounds|annual exposure-scaled sensitivity
limitation: The methodology-listed official ACS B25032/B25127 inputs and eight same-vintage annual structure/age/exposure constructions are implemented at county and Census-ZCTA geography; the structural exposure bounds are null before 2020 and are not legal eligibility determinations. Five 2020-2024 annual Los Angeles County sensitivities multiply the exact December county ZORI year-over-year change by the same-ending-year structural lower and upper exposure bounds without monthly carry-forward. These are not observed rent growth inside legally noncontrolled units. Exact noncontrolled_exposure_share and exact exposure-adjusted growth remain unavailable until a complete dated property-level policy/exemption crosswalk exists. The official-source scaffold is not applied, and Census ZCTAs are not USPS postal ZIPs.

why_hard_from_docx: County coverage uneven; time consistency varies
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Use Eviction Lab ETS only where the official release contains the geography; otherwise retain official annual modeled estimates at native annual frequency without interpolation.
limitation: The official ETS Version 3.0 release was checked on 2026-08-16 and contains neither Los Angeles nor any California geography; the official observed/validated county analysis files also contain no LA County rows. The implementation therefore retains official Eviction Lab annual county modeled estimates for 2000-2018, with source-observation flags and 95% credible interval bounds preserved. No annual value is interpolated or expanded to monthly frequency, and the series is not direct local court filing data.

why_hard_from_docx: No public "build-for-rent" flag in Census data
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Proxy using SFR permits in high-investor / rental-growth tracts or small MF permits.
limitation: The approved decision keeps this target closed. Generic one-unit permits do not identify rental tenure or investor intent, and the repository does not invent an investor/rental-growth tract classifier. Reopen only if a qualifying official public source and explicit method are approved.

why_hard_from_docx: ACS is annual; no quarterly public alternative
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Annual ACS change in occupied renter units; optionally interpolate or use CPS/HVS for state-level timing.
limitation: Fourteen consecutive-vintage annual county differences are implemented for 2011-2024, and 3,562 exact-ZCTA differences are implemented for 2012-2024. Both are panel-only constructions from direct acs_renter_occupied_units inputs and are not fact observations. Adjacent ACS five-year estimates overlap for four survey years, so neither result is a one-year flow; no quarterly timing is created, and Census ZCTAs are not postal ZIPs.

why_hard_from_docx: Income is annual; prices are monthly
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Construct ratio using annual ACS income with interpolated or stepwise series.
limitation: Fifteen annual LA County ACS ratios are implemented for 2010-2024. Matched-vintage ratios are also implemented for the 274 configured Census ZCTAs for 2011-2024, with six source-null ZCTA-vintages preserved and 3,830 non-null ratios. Both ratios are panel-only constructions rather than fact observations. No quarterly timing is invented, and Census ZCTAs are not postal ZIPs.

why_hard_from_docx: Birth/death data is annual at county level
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Annual CDC WONDER series; interpolate if quarterly timing is needed.
limitation: Annual CDC WONDER births and deaths are loaded as observed annual county facts; annual natural population change is births minus deaths. The quarterly series evenly allocates the annual total to four quarters and is flagged as imputed/interpolated timing, not observed quarterly vital events.

best_public_workaround_from_docx: Annual HUD PIT; no credible quarterly public alternative.
limitation: The official HUD PIT annual 2007-2025 CoC source and explicit CA-600/606/607/612 project composite are implemented. The source is annual point-in-time only, the composite is not Los Angeles County, and row-level sheltered-only, partial-unsheltered, and no-count records remain analytically incomplete. Explicit geography-year rows remain in CoC annual controls even when all three analytical values are null; the requested high-frequency target is still unavailable.

The annual ACS rental-availability proxy is for-rent vacant units divided by renter-occupied plus for-rent vacant units, using matched B25003 and B25004 estimates. Component 90% margins of error are retained, and unreliable county ratios are suppressed. Direct ACS counts and margins of error are retained at county and ZCTA geography; ZCTAs are not postal ZIPs. The eight active HUD-USPS variables are native-quarterly only and remain a separate all-residential measure. The vacancy proxy is (short-term vacant + long-term vacant) / total residential addresses, while no-stat remains a separate diagnostic. Direct provider components are observed at standardized 2020-tract geography; California county aggregates are constructed, and Los Angeles County postal-ZIP county-parts are modeled with the fixed 2026 Q1 crosswalk. Detailed tract and modeled ZIP-part derivatives remain access-controlled under the HUD-USPS sublicense. This is not true rental-listing inventory; ZORI is not inventory (it is a rent index), and Redfin for-sale active listings are not a valid substitute. The governing methodology names no approved source for the true monthly rental-listing series, so the blocker is a methodology/source-identification decision rather than a credential or coding step. The former derived package file was deleted; its historical quarantine manifest is superseded and is not an active input.
